notes: This file is a design proposal only. It is not wired into the engine or decks.
Classifications have no inherent rules. They matter only when card text refers to them.
Force + Bond + Name is a Named Formation.
Formation cards persist between Battles unless card text removes them.
Front/Middle/Rear are rows within each Front.
Move one position means one orthogonal step: one Front left/right in the same row, or one row forward/back in the same Front.

layout_spec.buried_rule_policy: Any continuing or recurring rule on a Force or Bond must be completely represented in its exposed strip. One-shot PLAY/NAMED text may be covered after it resolves.

PLAY.meaning: Resolve when this card is played. No memory after resolution unless it creates a marked temporary effect.

NAMED.meaning: Resolve when Force + Bond + Name is completed.

ACTION.meaning: Spend one Action to use this visible ability.

TRIGGER.meaning: Resolve when the printed event occurs. Recurring triggers must remain visible.

RESOLUTION.meaning: Resolve while this Front is being settled.

CONTINUOUS.meaning: Always active while its printed condition is true.

ONCE_PER_BATTLE.meaning: Place a used marker after use; remove used markers when the next Battle begins.

TEMPORARY_EFFECT.meaning: Place the stated marker on the affected formation or Front until the effect ends.

HIDDEN.meaning: The face-down Stratagem is itself the reminder until it is revealed.

physical_design_rules: Strength and Strength modifiers are read from the exposed top edge, not reconstructed from buried rules text.
Force Strength is printed as a base number; Bond and Name Strength use signed modifiers such as +1.
Command cost lives at the bottom because it matters in hand, not after stacking.
Classifications are visible interaction labels and never have inherent rules.
A recurring Force/Bond ability must fit in the exposed strip as icon plus short reminder.
If an effect remains after its source is discarded or hidden, represent it with a marker.
Most Forces are playable in Front, Middle, or Rear; hard row restrictions are exceptional.
